hooks.command: PKG="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/../.."; if [ -f "$PKG/cli/lib/preflight.mjs" ]; then (cd "$PKG" && node cli/lib/preflight.mjs --plugin design --warn-only); elif command -v maude >/dev/null 2>&1; then maude preflight --plugin design --warn-only; fi

PKG="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/../.."; if [ -f "$PKG/cli/bin/maude.mjs" ] && command -v node >/dev/null 2>&1; then node "$PKG/cli/bin/maude.mjs" design hook session-start; elif command -v maude >/dev/null 2>&1; then maude design hook session-start; fi; exit 0

PKG="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/../.."; if [ -f "$PKG/cli/bin/maude.mjs" ] && command -v node >/dev/null 2>&1; then node "$PKG/cli/bin/maude.mjs" design hook prompt; elif command -v maude >/dev/null 2>&1; then maude design hook prompt; fi; exit 0

PKG="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/../.."; if [ -f "$PKG/cli/bin/maude.mjs" ] && command -v node >/dev/null 2>&1; then node "$PKG/cli/bin/maude.mjs" design hook pre-edit; elif command -v maude >/dev/null 2>&1; then maude design hook pre-edit; fi; exit 0

PKG="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/../.."; if [ -f "$PKG/cli/bin/maude.mjs" ] && command -v node >/dev/null 2>&1; then node "$PKG/cli/bin/maude.mjs" design hook pre-bash; elif command -v maude >/dev/null 2>&1; then maude design hook pre-bash; fi; exit 0

INPUT=$(cat); case "$INPUT" in *'.design/'*'.tsx'*|*'.design/'*'.css'*|*'.design/'*'components.json'*) ;; *) exit 0 ;; esac; command -v maude >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; printf '%s' "$INPUT" | maude design ds-check --hook --root "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}" 2>/dev/null; exit 0

PKG="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/../.."; if [ -f "$PKG/cli/bin/maude.mjs" ] && command -v node >/dev/null 2>&1; then node "$PKG/cli/bin/maude.mjs" design hook post-edit; elif command -v maude >/dev/null 2>&1; then maude design hook post-edit; fi; exit 0

PKG="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/../.."; if [ -f "$PKG/cli/bin/maude.mjs" ] && command -v node >/dev/null 2>&1; then node "$PKG/cli/bin/maude.mjs" design hook post-bash; elif command -v maude >/dev/null 2>&1; then maude design hook post-bash; fi; exit 0

PKG="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/../.."; if [ -f "$PKG/cli/bin/maude.mjs" ] && command -v node >/dev/null 2>&1; then node "$PKG/cli/bin/maude.mjs" design hook stop; elif command -v maude >/dev/null 2>&1; then maude design hook stop; fi; exit 0

PKG="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/../.."; if [ -f "$PKG/cli/bin/maude.mjs" ] && command -v node >/dev/null 2>&1; then node "$PKG/cli/bin/maude.mjs" design hook subagent-start; elif command -v maude >/dev/null 2>&1; then maude design hook subagent-start; fi; exit 0

PKG="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/../.."; if [ -f "$PKG/cli/bin/maude.mjs" ] && command -v node >/dev/null 2>&1; then node "$PKG/cli/bin/maude.mjs" design hook stop; elif command -v maude >/dev/null 2>&1; then maude design hook stop; fi; exit 0
